English.Char_Desc_2000:
SWEEPR Cleaner is a modern, ultra-lightweight PC cleaner and privacy optimization utility built in native Rust for Windows 10 and Windows 11.
Designed specifically as an alternative to legacy PC cleaners that have become bloated with background daemons, telemetry, and popup ads, SWEEPR Cleaner delivers maximum disk recovery with zero system overhead.
Key Features: - Native Rust Engine (5.4 MB): Starts instantly, consumes under 40 MB of RAM during execution, and finishes deep system scans in under 60 seconds. - Zero Background Processes: SWEEPR runs strictly on-demand with no startup services or background CPU usage. - 7-Day Quarantine & 1-Click Rollback: Isolates removed caches into a secure quarantine so you can restore files with one click. - DeepClean Cache Engine: Cleans Windows Temp, AppData, browser caches (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave), GPU shader caches, and diagnostic crash dumps. - Smart App Uninstaller: Discovers and erases stubborn leftovers, orphaned folders, and stale registry keys left behind by standard Windows uninstalls. - Duplicate File Finder: Uses cryptographic SHA-256 byte verification to safely detect and remove identical duplicate files. - Secure File Shredder: Meets DoD 5220.22-M sanitization standards for permanent deletion of sensitive personal files.
